extraFacts.fact: 1 bar = 14.5038 psi; 140 psi is about 10 bar, 300 psi about 21 bar and 3,000 psi about 207 bar.

Maker pressure figures in the range listings are working pressures; burst pressure in the size tables is a test figure, not a working limit, and end fittings must come from the series the hose maker approves.

faqs.q: What is the ATP coiled air hose assembly used for?
faqs.a: ATP coiled air hose assemblies are ready-made polyurethane coiled hoses with brass male NPT ends and a strain relief at each end, for compressed air and fresh water. The listing carries 75 part numbers in 1/4" and 3/8" bore, in light blue, navy blue and red.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the ATP coiled air hose assembly come in?
faqs.a: The assemblies are listed in 1/4" (30 part numbers) and 3/8" (45 part numbers) inside diameter, in 8, 12, 16, 20 and 24 ft hose lengths. Colours are light blue, navy blue and red; some part numbers end -QC for a quick coupler.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the ATP coiled air hose assembly?

faqs.q: What lengths and colours do ATP coiled air hose assemblies come in?
faqs.a: Hose lengths in the table are 8, 12, 16, 20 and 24 ft, each in light blue, navy blue or red. The colour code in the part number is LB, NB or R, as in TT-14-20-LB-RS-QC (1/4", light blue) and TT-14-15-R-RS-QC (red).

faqs.q: What is the ATP coiled air hose assembly made of?
faqs.a: The tube and cover are both polyurethane, and the ends are brass MNPT fittings with a strain relief. The listing names air and fresh water as the compatible fluids; it does not list oils or chemicals.

faqs.q: What safety factor is listed for ATP coiled air hose assemblies?
faqs.a: The listing gives the safety factor as 31, which looks like a 3:1 figure. We therefore quote only the 140 psi working pressure stated by the maker; ask us for the maker's data sheet if you need burst figures.

faqs.q: What connects to ATP coiled air hose assemblies?
faqs.a: Both ends are MNPT brass, so they mate with female NPT ports or couplers. Quick-coupler versions, with -QC in the part number, take a matching plug; see [universal air couplings](/c/universal-air-couplings) and [Chicago, claw and crowfoot couplers](/blog/universal-air-couplings-explained).

faqs.q: ATP coiled air hose or Dixon polyurethane self-storing air hose: which should I buy?

faqs.q: How should a coiled air hose assembly be installed and cared for?
faqs.a: Keep the coil from being stretched past its working length, avoid sharp edges and fit the quick coupler to a matching plug. faqs.q: Which sizes does the Alemite low-pressure air/water hose come in?

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Alemite low-pressure air/water hose?

faqs.q: What is the Alemite low-pressure air/water hose made of?

faqs.q: How do I check Alemite air/water hose ratings before ordering?

faqs.q: What threads do Alemite air/water hoses have?

faqs.q: What is the Continental bulk air hose used for?
faqs.a: Continental bulk air hoses are black EPDM-tube, EPDM-cover air hoses sold by the length in five colours: black, blue, gray, red and yellow. The listing carries 152 part numbers, and the maker's pressure runs from 200 to 500 psi by series.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the Continental bulk air hose come in?
faqs.a: The listing has 152 part numbers in 200, 250, 300 and 500 psi series, in black, blue, gray, red and yellow. Bore and length are in the part number, for example PLB10025-100 or HZB05020-25-G; the size table gives the bore per row.

faqs.q: How do I identify Continental part numbers such as HZB10020-100-G?
faqs.a: HZB10020-100-G is the Air Hose, 1 Inch Hose ID, Black, 200 PSI and HZY02530-100-G is the Air Hose, 1/4 Inch Hose ID, Yellow, 300 PSI. The size table lists all 152 part numbers, each with its own bore, length and rating, so match those to the line rather than the series name.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Continental bulk air hose?
faqs.a: The maker states 200 to 500 psi (14 to 34 bar) by series: 200 psi is 14 bar, 250 psi is 17 bar, 300 psi is 21 bar and 500 psi is 34 bar. Each part number has its own rating, and the safety factor is 4:1, so check the row for your part.

faqs.q: What temperature range does Continental bulk air hose cover?
faqs.a: The maker states -40°F to +210°F for the EPDM tube and cover. That covers outdoor winter air lines and warm workshop service; for steam or hotter media use a hose built for it.

faqs.q: What is the Continental bulk air hose made of?
faqs.a: The tube and cover are EPDM, the hose is black-based with coloured covers for line identification, and there is no strain relief on bulk hose. EPDM resists ozone and weather but not petroleum oil.

faqs.q: What safety factor does Continental bulk air hose have?
faqs.a: The listing gives a 4:1 safety factor, so the burst pressure is four times the working pressure; for the 250 psi series that is 69 bar burst against 17 bar working. Couplings must match; see [industrial hose safety factors](/blog/industrial-hose-safety-factors).

faqs.q: What couplings go on Continental bulk air hose?
faqs.a: Bulk hose is cut to length and needs hose-barb or crimp-style ends held with clamps or ferrules, sized to the bore. See [universal air couplings](/c/universal-air-couplings) and [hose clamps, sleeves and ferrules](/c/hose-clamps-sleeves-ferrules).

faqs.q: Continental bulk air hose or Continental push-on air hose: which should I order?

faqs.q: How do I choose the right pressure series of Continental bulk air hose?

faqs.q: How do I identify Continental part numbers such as IGBK05025-100-G?
faqs.a: IGBK05025-100-G is the Air Hose, 1/2 Inch Hose ID, Black, 250 PSI and IGRD02525-150-G is the Air Hose, 1/4 Inch Hose ID, Red, 250 PSI. The size table lists all 123 part numbers, each with its own bore, length and rating, so match those to the line rather than the series name.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Continental push-on air hose?
faqs.a: The maker states 250 to 400 psi (17 to 28 bar) by series: 250 psi is 17 bar, 300 psi is 21 bar and the single 3/4" 400 psi part is 28 bar. Each part has its own rating, so read the row and match the fitting to it.

faqs.q: What temperature range does Continental push-on air hose cover?
faqs.a: The maker states -20°F to +210°F. The nitrile tube and cover cope with oil mist in the air line; keep it away from hot surfaces and steam.

faqs.q: What is the Continental push-on air hose made of?
faqs.a: The tube and cover are nitrile, which resists oil mist and petroleum oils better than EPDM, and the hose is bulk with no strain relief. The listing names deionized, fresh and salt water as compatible fluids.

faqs.q: What ratings are listed for Continental push-on air hose?
faqs.a: Burst pressure is listed as 69 bar for the 250 psi series, 83 bar for the 300 psi series and 110 bar for the 400 psi part, which is a 4:1 margin on the working pressure. No standards or certificates are listed for this range.

faqs.q: What fittings go on Continental push-on air hose?

faqs.q: Continental push-on air hose or Parker Jiffy push-on hose?

faqs.q: How do you fit push-on air hose to a barb?

faqs.q: What is the Dixon grease whip hose assembly used for?

faqs.q: Which sizes does the Dixon grease whip hose assembly come in?

faqs.q: How do I identify Dixon part numbers such as GWH3600?

faqs.q: What is the Dixon grease whip hose assembly made of?

faqs.q: What thread do Dixon grease whip hose assemblies have?

faqs.q: What connects to a Dixon grease whip hose?
faqs.a: The 1/8"-27 NPT male ends screw into a grease gun outlet and a coupler or fitting with a 1/8" female NPT port. See [universal air couplings](/c/universal-air-couplings) for related ends; our team can match the adapter to your gun.

faqs.q: Dixon grease whip hose with strain relief spring or the plain version: which?

faqs.q: How do I identify Dixon part numbers such as FHPR150-50CBF?

faqs.q: What is the Dixon pin rack hose assembly made of?

faqs.q: What thread is on a Dixon pin rack hose assembly?

faqs.q: What connects to a Dixon pin rack hose assembly?

faqs.q: Which sizes does the Dixon polyurethane air hose come in?

faqs.q: How do I identify Dixon part numbers such as 650-6S?

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Dixon polyurethane air hose?
faqs.a: The size table lists 14 bar for both part numbers. Polyurethane is flexible and light, but pressure falls as the temperature rises, so for hot environments ask for the maker's curve.

faqs.q: What is the Dixon polyurethane air hose made of?

faqs.q: Which standards apply to Dixon polyurethane air hose?

faqs.q: What does 650-6S versus 650-4S mean on Dixon polyurethane air hose?

faqs.q: Dixon polyurethane air hose or the Dixon self-storing air hose: what is the difference?

faqs.q: Which sizes does the Dixon self-storing air hose come in?

faqs.q: What is the Dixon self-storing air hose made of?

faqs.q: What resistance properties does Dixon self-storing air hose have?

faqs.q: What threads do Dixon self-storing air hoses have?
